subject: 2025 City Council Leadership Caucus
overview: The Committee of the Whole met to designate city council leadership for the 2025 term. The committee designated Zac Bears as President-Elect and Kit Collins as Vice President-Elect.

items.title: 2025 City Council Leadership Designation
items.summary: The committee designated Kit Collins as Vice President-Elect and Zac Bears as President-Elect for 2025, with formal confirmation votes scheduled for the first regular meeting in January.
